API conventions will stay at the Java implementation level. Exact HTTP paths and JSON schemas will remain in spec/api-contract.md. The architecture package layout example will become the approved convention.

Settled on the approved package layout: api, domain, service, persistence, rag, and config. Chose `rag` over `ai` for clarity. Base package will remain unspecified.

The base package will be a single root under `src/main/java` without inventing a company name. A second Spring Boot application must not be introduced.

Java 21 records will be used for request and response DTOs. This replaces the previous rule against mandating Java records.

JPA entities will map directly to Liquibase tables. Explicit `@Table` and `@Column` names must match the changelog. Implicit Hibernate naming is not the source of truth. Error handling is next.

ProblemDetail is native to Spring Boot 3, yet the public error JSON contract will remain unfrozen per api-standards. The Spring layer will use @RestController, @Valid on @RequestBody, and ResponseEntity or typed returns. Controllers must not expose entities directly. MapStruct is discouraged; explicit mapping via dedicated classes or static factory methods is preferred. Jakarta EE packages are required instead of javax.

Explicit constructors are preferred over Lombok. Sealed types may optionally replace domain errors. @Transactional belongs on services only. Repositories must not contain business logic. Derived queries or @Query handle keyword search. Custom update queries must not bypass the ticket state machine.

Persistence entities are not the public API. They must not contain state-machine logic. Full DDD aggregates are unnecessary for this application size.

Domain types such as status enums and transition rules are independent of JPA. Entity-to-domain mapping belongs in the service layer or a dedicated mapper.

Configuration follows Spring Boot conventions. Use application.yml with profiles and environment variables for secrets. RAG settings like top-K and threshold use @ConfigurationProperties. Hardcoded Ollama URLs are forbidden.

spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto must be validate or none. It must never replace Liquibase. All Instant fields use UTC timezone.

Testing guidance points to testing.md. This file does not duplicate test rules.

The final document stays under 500 lines. The assessment explicitly wants this as a Java Spring Boot guidelines catalogue.

Expanding the existing file is correct because splitting would violate the instruction to edit only those two files.
